notes: In the documented dispatch scenario, open the day in the calendar. Unassigned jobs appear above the aircraft rows. Open the job to check route, load and requested time. Drag it to a free aircraft at that time. Reopen the flight to verify Scheduled, the selected aircraft and assigned pilot. The dispatcher reviews planning warnings.
In the fair staging scenario, accepting an offer creates an order and flights. Use the daily plan PDF to share the schedule; the example had empty client, location and fuel columns.

OPS Agent day-plan demonstration proposes an aircraft and pilot; after confirmation the dispatcher checks the calendar. The recorded feature is restricted to NGFT administrators; do not present it as available to every dispatcher.
In OPS a Job is the customer job and may contain multiple Flights. Each Flight is planned on an aircraft.
Scheduled and Engaged are distinct states. The team notification is associated with Engage, not just putting the flight on the calendar.

notes: Own external certificate: open the course list and use Upload beside the course, choose the file, enter Completion Date and Valid Until (or tick Certificate never expires), then Upload Certificate. The entry shows Awaiting approval.

A manager with Approve extern certificates opens Approve Courses, clicks the filename to review it, and can use the pencil to correct dates. Confirm the green thumb to approve or red thumb to decline. Both decisions are final in this workflow. A normal upload by a manager also waits for approval.

Managers with Bulk upload certificates can use One Certificate, Multiple Users after a shared training day, or One User, Multiple Certificates for one person. Select course(s) and member(s), supply the common file and dates, then Upload & Approve. These uploads count immediately. Company Administrator does not have this permission by default.

If courses or certificates seem to belong to the wrong company, check the company at the top. For a user working for multiple companies, use the three dots beside the company name, select the company, and wait for the page to reload.

Course appears unfinished: reopen it with the play arrow and check every Moodle component, including the feedback form where present. A composite training can have unfinished parts; expand it for progress. For a manager seeing stale red in Overview, use its refresh arrow to recalculate.

Missing course: ask the manager to check assigned roles, positions, operations and the company Relations Tree. Missing menu entries depend on permissions. To check a missing operation for a member, review Members > Properties, then aircraft assignment and the Allowed switch under Aircraft & Operation Authorization / Limitations.
